meta.title: Valorant to Fortnite Sensitivity Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert Valorant sensitivity to Fortnite. Same mouse feel in both games.
sensConverterDesc: Enter your sensitivity and DPI — conversion updates automatically.
cm360Desc: Distance your mouse must travel for one full 360° rotation
steps_valorant-to-fortnite-sensitivity_1: Input your Valorant sensitivity. The converter scales it for Fortnite's third-person perspective and faster-paced gameplay.
steps_valorant-to-fortnite-sensitivity_2: Your Fortnite equivalent sensitivity appears. This is your hipfire sensitivity — targeting and scope sensitivities may need separate tuning.
steps_valorant-to-fortnite-sensitivity_3: Apply in Fortnite. Test in Creative mode — Fortnite requires both accurate shooting and quick building, so sensitivity is a balance of both.
